import stripe
import requests
BOOKING_SERVICE_URL = 'https://internal.bookings.example.com'

def charge_and_add_traveler_access(customer_id, booking_ref, amount_cents, companion_user_id):
    created_payment_intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount_cents, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, confirm=True, metadata={'booking_ref': booking_ref})
    access_grant_response = requests.post(f'{BOOKING_SERVICE_URL}/bookings/{booking_ref}/permissions', json={'user_id': companion_user_id, 'role': 'manager'}, timeout=15)
    access_grant_response.raise_for_status()
    # Remove any pending access invitations for this companion on the booking
    invite_cleanup_response = requests.delete(f'{BOOKING_SERVICE_URL}/bookings/{booking_ref}/invitations/{companion_user_id}', timeout=15)
    if invite_cleanup_response.status_code not in (200, 204, 404):
        invite_cleanup_response.raise_for_status()
    return {'payment_intent_id': created_payment_intent.id, 'status': created_payment_intent.status, 'granted_to': companion_user_id}
